targetDefinition: DFLD-reported direction in the 30-minute bin starting at the valid forecast hour; not exact switch timing

split.target: DFLD-reported direction in the 30-minute bin starting at the valid forecast hour; not exact switch timing
split.timezone: Europe/Berlin, empirically checked against UTC METAR; not explicitly declared by provider
split.selection: Lowest validation Brier per horizon, never test tuning. Retain original fitted training coefficients for test and deployment.
baselines: frozen v1 direction model re-scored on identical actual-label test rows
challenge weather rules on identical archived weather, initialized from origin weather proxy
split.baselineRuleSteps: First future hour through valid time; aligned with browser, excludes origin step 0
split.dataAvailability: DFLD is a target only, never an origin feature. Origin METAR and fixed-offset archived ICON only; exact delivery timestamps unavailable.
split.deploymentRule: Deploy validation-selected direction models. Report all test outcomes, including regressions. Never alter closure coefficients or thresholds.
split.uncertainty: Paired daily-block bootstrap of test Brier differences, 1000 draws, fixed seed 20261030; retrospective uncertainty, not operational certification

limitations: Direction labels are DFLD-reported Fraport-based half-hour bins; exact switch timing is not known.
Europe/Berlin time basis is empirically checked; DST transition day is excluded.
DFLD records are targets only. Exact weather delivery timestamps are unavailable; evaluation is retrospective.
Six months cover a limited seasonal range; correlated hourly rows and few switch events limit generalization.
Closure model and alert policies are unchanged. No actual RWY18 closure labels were obtained.
Probabilities are fitted scores, not operational certainty. Intermediate leads use the nearest tested horizon.
